---
name: Bug report (Markdown)
about: File a bug using the markdown fallback template
title: "[Bug]: <short summary>"
labels:
  - type:bug
assignees: ''
---

## :loudspeaker: Introduction
Explain the failure, severity, and impacted workflow in 2-3 sentences.

## :clipboard: Requirements
List the environment context (OS, runtime versions, template version, feature flags, auth/tenant info).

## :building_construction: Structure
Provide numbered reproduction steps plus expected vs. actual behavior checkpoints.

## :page_facing_up: Files
Link or attach logs, stack traces, screenshots, anonymized payloads, or configs.

## :warning: Warnings
Describe outage scope, blockers, and any temporary mitigation taken (rollback, feature flag, etc.).

## :link: See also
Reference related issues, documentation sections, dashboards, or discussions.
